notes_for_editor: Two sources, both agreeing the tower is gone. Two web searches found no build date, builder, staffing or fire history for this Trinity County tower; the Wildwood and Peanut hits were 2025 fire news, not lookouts. The 1961 station description is the only physical description. Shasta-Trinity ranger district files or the Trinity County Historical Society are the likely next checks. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the Ron Kemnow name was dropped from the citation, because the page credits him only with a photo, not as author.
